description: Let the existing completed House full-rest cycle recover Mara current bodily injury without erasing its historical fact.

replacements.old:
<COND (,SHADOW-GARLIC-SCENT

    <COND (.SEEN <REST-PUT ,RS-EVENT-RECOVERY T>)>
